title_zh: 曝苹果 AI 国行版 12 月上线，新版 Siri 或缺席
content_zh:
据彭博社 10 月 15 日报道，苹果计划于今年 12 月随 iOS 27.3 更新，正式在中国内地推出 Apple Intelligence（苹果智能），但首批上线的主要是两年前推出的初代 AI 功能，全新 Siri 暂时缺席。

首批功能预计包括 Genmoji 自定义表情、通知摘要、写作工具及照片物体消除等。为满足监管要求，Image Playground 等图像生成功能将暂时缺席，部分文本生成功能也受到限制。今年推出的新版 Siri、增强版 Genmoji、照片扩展等功能同样不会同步上线。

昨天，工信部电信设备进网许可信息显示，iPhone Duo 国行版（A3721）的许可证已于 9 月 29 日更新，新增 Apple 智能、阿里巴巴通义万相和通义千问的大模型备案编号。iPhone 15 Pro／Pro Max 及后续多款机型也出现相同变更，iPhone 15、15 Plus 及更早机型则未更新。

报道称，苹果已于今年 7 月获得初步监管许可，并与阿里巴巴合作开发符合中国监管要求的 AI 安全机制，同时与百度合作开发搜索及 Siri 相关功能。

Apple Intelligence 原计划于 2025 年 5 月进入中国市场，此后多次推迟。面对国产手机厂商不断迭代的 AI 功能，苹果这套两年前的初代 AI 能力能否获得用户认可，仍有待观察。
title_en: Apple Intelligence Set for December Launch in China, but Upgraded Siri Will Be Missing
content_en:
Apple is planning to officially roll out Apple Intelligence in Mainland China this December alongside an upcoming iOS update, according to a report by Bloomberg. However, the initial release will primarily feature earlier-generation AI capabilities, with the newly upgraded Siri notably absent.

The first batch of features is expected to include custom Genmoji, notification summaries, writing tools, and object removal in photos. To comply with local regulatory requirements, image generation tools like Image Playground and certain text generation features will be restricted or temporarily omitted.

Recent regulatory filings from China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) reveal that domestic iPhone approvals have been updated to incorporate model registrations for Apple Intelligence, as well as Alibaba's Tongyi Qwen and Tongyi Wanxiang models. Apple reportedly secured preliminary regulatory approval in July, partnering with Alibaba for AI safety compliance and Baidu for search and Siri-related capabilities.

title_zh: 苹果双 11 优惠公布：iPhone 17 立减 1000 元，iPhone 18 Pro 优惠 300 元
content_zh:
天猫 Apple Store 官方旗舰店上线双 11 活动预告，宣布今年的双 11 促销将于 10 月 20 日开启，iPhone 17 和 iPhone 18 Pro 均将推出限时优惠。

iPhone 17 可享 1000 元购机优惠，符合条件的用户还可叠加最高 500 元国家补贴，并支持免息分期；iPhone 18 Pro 则可享 300 元优惠，同时提供以旧换新政府补贴 500 元及 12 期免息分期。

优惠后，iPhone 17 和 iPhone 18 Pro 分别为 5299 元和 9699 元。
title_en: Apple Announces Double 11 Discounts in China for iPhone 17 and iPhone 18 Pro
content_en:
Apple's official Tmall flagship store has unveiled its upcoming "Double 11" shopping festival promotions, set to launch on October 20. The event features limited-time discounts across multiple iPhone models.

Under the promotion, the iPhone 17 will receive a flat discount of 1,000 RMB, with eligible buyers able to stack an additional national subsidy of up to 500 RMB along with interest-free installment options. Meanwhile, the iPhone 18 Pro will offer a 300 RMB discount, alongside a 500 RMB government trade-in subsidy and 12-month interest-free financing.

Following these applied discounts and subsidies, starting prices drop to 5,299 RMB for the iPhone 17 and 9,699 RMB for the iPhone 18 Pro.

title_zh: 苹果公布 HomeView 维修费：保修外服务预估 279 美元
content_zh:
苹果公布了 HomeView 智能家庭中枢在美国的维修收费：桌面版和壁挂版的保修外服务预估均为 279 美元，收费项目列为「其他损坏」。

值得注意的是，这款设备的新机售价为 299 美元。

如果设备有 AppleCare 保障，意外损坏服务费为 39 美元，同样适用于两种机型。苹果将这项费用统一列为「意外损坏」，未按屏幕、扬声器等部件拆分报价。

苹果支持页说明，设备须经检查才能确定最终服务费，报价可能另加税费和邮寄费；授权服务商的保修外收费可以不同，AppleCare 保障下的服务费则与苹果一致。

HomeView 两种机型均已开放预购，11 月 13 日开始发货。桌面版附带内置扬声器的底座，壁挂版的壁挂支架和电源适配器需要另购。
title_en: Apple Discloses HomeView Repair Costs: Out-of-Warranty Fee Set at $279
content_en:
Apple has disclosed the estimated repair costs for its new HomeView smart home hub in the United States. Out-of-warranty service for both the desktop and wall-mounted versions is estimated at $279 under the "Other Damage" category—just $20 less than the device's $299 retail price.

For customers covered by AppleCare, the service fee for accidental damage drops to $39 for either model. Apple lists this flat fee under general accidental damage rather than breaking down pricing by individual components like screen or speaker replacements.

Both HomeView models are currently available for pre-order, with shipments scheduled to begin on November 13. The desktop version comes equipped with a speaker base, whereas the wall-mount bracket and power adapter for the wall-mounted version must be purchased separately.

title_zh: OPPO 与 Manus 合作，Find X10 将首发 AI Mind Pilot 智能体模式
content_zh:
OPPO 与 Manus 宣布合作，将 Manus 的智能体能力接入 AI Mind Pilot 新增的 Agent Mode，首发机型为搭载 ColorOS 17 的 OPPO Find X10 系列。

据双方官方介绍，该模式可理解目标、拆解多步任务，并结合手机内的文件、照片及在线信息产出结果。例如，它可以汇总散落在不同应用中的机票、酒店和景点预订，生成按天安排的行程；也可整理旅行照片，或依据现有文件生成演示文稿、提案与作品集。

本地查找、整理和重命名等任务通过端侧模型处理，原始文件与照片不会分享给 Manus；需要外部处理时，系统先要求用户明确授权。OPPO 官方还表示，Agent Mode 初期同时支持 Manus 和 ChatGPT，部分地区提供免费使用额度，已有订阅用户可连接自己的账号。具体开放市场与权益安排将随产品发布公布。
title_en: OPPO Partners with Manus to Debut AI Agent Mode on Find X10 Series
content_en:
OPPO has announced a strategic partnership with AI startup Manus to introduce advanced AI agent capabilities into its new AI Mind Pilot "Agent Mode." The feature will debut on the upcoming OPPO Find X10 series powered by ColorOS 17.

Designed to handle complex workflows, the Agent Mode can break down multi-step objectives by synthesizing local files, photos, and online information. For instance, it can automatically gather scattered flight, hotel, and attraction bookings across apps to generate daily travel itineraries, organize photo libraries, or draft presentations and proposals from existing documents.

To ensure user privacy, routine tasks like local file searches and organization are processed entirely on-device, keeping raw files off external servers. Tasks requiring third-party cloud processing will require explicit user authorization. At launch, Agent Mode will support both Manus and ChatGPT, offering free usage quotas in select regions along with account-linking options for existing subscribers.

title_zh: 豆包手机助手第三方应用操作权限开放：腾讯系、阿里系、拼多多等拒绝
content_zh:
豆包手机助手于 10 月 14 日宣布，《屏幕自动化操作声明协议》（SAEP）的 30 天公示期已结束，将逐步放开第三方应用的屏幕自动化操作权限。不过，已明确拒绝的应用仍不会被智能体操作。

此次更新的清单涉及努比亚 M153 和努比亚 NaviX Ultra。

值得注意的是，微信、企业微信、QQ、淘宝、支付宝、美团及其关联应用均在拒绝名单中，拼多多、小红书、米家、DeepSeek、Kimi 以及三家电信运营商的应用也已声明拒绝。

开发者可通过技术接入，按应用、页面和操作意图细分允许或禁止的范围，也可填写表单或发送邮件完成配置。

公示期结束后，两条声明渠道均长期有效、可随时变更，官方承诺在 3 个工作日内反馈。
title_en: Doubao AI Assistant Opens Screen Automation as Major Chinese Tech Apps Opt Out
content_en:
Doubao Phone Assistant has officially concluded its 30-day public notice period for its Screen Automation Operation Protocol (SAEP), initiating a gradual rollout of third-party app automation permissions. The feature update currently applies to users on Nubia M153 and Nubia NaviX Ultra devices.

However, a significant number of major Chinese technology platforms have explicitly opted out. Applications from Tencent (WeChat, WeCom, QQ), Alibaba (Taobao, Alipay), Meituan, Pinduoduo, Xiaohongshu, Xiaomi’s Mijia, DeepSeek, Kimi, and China's top three telecom operators are all listed as refused. Doubao's AI agents will strictly refrain from executing automated actions on these platforms.

App developers retain the ability to granularly allow or restrict automated operations by specific apps, pages, or user intents through technical integration or direct requests. Doubao confirmed that configuration channels remain open permanently, with updates processed within three business days.

title_zh: 田柯宇自述停掉同事训练任务，前团队成员公开质疑
content_zh:
前字节跳动实习生田柯宇在《elsewhere 别处发生》访谈中，首次较完整地讲述自己干扰模型训练的经过。随着节目公开，前团队成员发布长文反驳，围绕行为动机、持续时间和影响范围提出另一套说法。

访谈文字版于 10 月 12 日发布，制作方说明，采访录制于今年 7 月。田柯宇称，当时一名实习生占用过多算力并停掉他人任务，向负责人反馈未果后，自己让 GPT 编写程序，在约 10 天内手动停止或卡住对方的训练任务约 5 次。他承认违反公司规定、浪费公司资源，但否认持续攻击训练集群及嫁祸他人的说法。

据界面新闻和鞭牛士报道，前同事公开的说明材料认为，这一自述与当年的项目异常及技术记录存在出入，并提醒投资人与合作方向知情者核实。材料还提出有关模型演示真实性的指控。田柯宇与前同事的这些表述属于相互冲突的当事人说法；访谈中，他表示相关民事案件仍在二审。
title_en: Former ByteDance Intern's Model Sabotage Narrative Sparks Rebuttal from Ex-Teammates
content_en:
A controversy has resurfaced surrounding former ByteDance intern Tian Keyu after he gave a detailed account of his involvement in disrupting AI model training during a recent media interview. Following the interview's release, former team members publicly disputed Tian's version of events, challenging his statements regarding motives, timeline, and overall impact.

In the interview recorded in July and published on October 12, Tian admitted to using a GPT-generated script to halt or freeze a colleague's training tasks roughly five times over a 10-day period. He claimed the action was prompted by the colleague monopolizing compute resources after management failed to intervene. While acknowledging that he breached company policy and wasted resources, Tian denied launching continuous attacks on the cluster or framing others.

Former colleagues countered in statements cited by local tech media, arguing that technical logs and project records contradict Tian's account. They cautioned investors and industry partners to verify facts with insiders and raised additional concerns regarding the authenticity of past model demonstrations. Tian noted that related civil litigation remains under second-instance legal review.

title_zh: 小鹏向全球开放技术合作，整车平台、芯片与机器人均可输出
content_zh:
小鹏集团董事长兼 CEO 何小鹏在巴黎车展期间介绍智能汽车解决方案业务「XPENG AI ENGINEERING」，面向全球合作伙伴开放从整车研发、生产到售后的一站式技术合作。据财联社 10 月 14 日报道，合作方可以选择完整平台，也可采用单项技术模块。

汽车技术分为三部分：整车平台包括平台架构与电子电气架构；模块化技术涵盖智驾、AIBOX、图灵 AI 芯片、电池和电驱；配套工具链包括远程标定、整车下线检测及 AI 售后诊断。

小鹏同步开放人形机器人、Robotaxi、飞行汽车、图灵 AI 芯片和物理世界基座模型等物理 AI 生态方案。何小鹏透露，Robotaxi 业务正在与欧洲多家头部出行平台深度洽谈，后续合作进展将对外公布。

大众与小鹏的合作是这一技术输出路径已有的实践。小鹏也已组建集团级商务拓展团队，推动芯片、智驾模型、Robotaxi 与人形机器人技术进入全球市场。
title_en: XPeng Opens Technology Ecosystem Globally, Offering Vehicle Platforms, AI Chips, and Robotics
content_en:
At the Paris Motor Show, XPeng Chairman and CEO He Xiaopeng announced "XPENG AI ENGINEERING," a new initiative offering global partners one-stop technology cooperation spanning vehicle R&D, manufacturing, and post-sales support. Partners can opt for complete platform licensing or select individual technology modules.

The company's automotive offerings cover full vehicle and electronic architectures, modular technologies—including smart driving systems, Turing AI chips, and electric drivetrains—as well as comprehensive toolchains. XPeng is also opening up its broader physical AI ecosystem, which encompasses humanoid robotics, Robotaxis, flying cars, and physical foundation models.

Building on its successful partnership with Volkswagen, XPeng has established a dedicated group-level business development team to drive its global tech exports. Notably, the company is in advanced negotiations with several leading European mobility platforms regarding its Robotaxi business.

title_zh: 小米 Vision GT 今日加入《跑车浪漫旅 7》，30 周年手柄 12 月发售
content_zh:
小米汽车宣布，Xiaomi Vision GT 将于北京时间 10 月 15 日 14:00 正式加入《跑车浪漫旅 7》。这款电动概念超跑是首台中国 Vision GT，采用水滴形座舱、环形尾灯与贯穿车身的空气通道，玩家可在游戏的品牌中心购买。

同期免费推出的 Spec IV 第一部分更新还带来另外五辆车，以及日本 SUGO 国际赛车场。新增功能包括按品牌体验驾驶挑战、从不同角度查看车辆的 Car Viewer，以及帮助玩家寻找指定旧车的 Car Concierge；后者面向已完成游戏结局的玩家开放。

索尼同时公布《GT 赛车》30 周年限量版 DualSense 手柄，采用赛车条纹、赛车主题图案和碳纤维风格面板。手柄将于 10 月 22 日开放预订，12 月 10 日起在全球发售，美国建议零售价为 84.99 美元。
title_en: Xiaomi Vision GT Debuts in Gran Turismo 7 Alongside Limited-Edition Controller Announcement
content_en:
Xiaomi EV has officially debuted the Xiaomi Vision GT concept supercar in *Gran Turismo 7*, making it the first Chinese Vision GT vehicle featured in the franchise. The futuristic electric concept supercar features a teardrop canopy, ring taillights, and integrated airflow channels, and is now available for purchase in the game's Brand Central.

The release coincides with the free Spec IV Part 1 update, which introduces five additional vehicles, Japan's Sportsland SUGO circuit, and new gameplay features such as brand-specific driving challenges, an interactive Car Viewer, and a Car Concierge tool for endgame players.

In tandem with the update, Sony unveiled a 30th Anniversary Limited Edition *Gran Turismo* DualSense wireless controller. Featuring racing-themed graphics, classic racing stripes, and carbon-fiber style accents, the controller opens for pre-orders on October 22 and launches globally on December 10 for $84.99.

title_zh: YouTube Music 开始标注 AI 音乐，标签将扩展至主应用
content_zh:
YouTube 10 月 14 日宣布，YouTube Music 开始为主要使用生成式 AI 创作的歌曲添加标签，涵盖以生成模型制作曲子、演唱等情况。标签会直接出现在播放页面，点击后可查看 AI 参与创作的更多信息，之后也将扩展至 YouTube 主应用。

平台将结合音乐合作伙伴的申报和自身检测工具识别相关内容。官方帮助页把申报分为「完全由生成式 AI 制作」「部分使用生成式 AI」和「未使用生成式 AI」三类；合作伙伴没有申报时，平台仍可根据其他信号判定歌曲是否涉及 AI。

分类也给出了具体边界：用 AI 生成伴奏、再由真人演唱，属于部分使用；用 AI 协助写歌词或旋律，也需要相应披露。普通 Auto-Tune 修音，以及用自动母带工具调整均衡、压缩和音色，不被归入生成式 AI 创作。
title_en: YouTube Music Introduces Labels to Identify AI-Generated Songs
content_en:
YouTube has announced that YouTube Music is rolling out labels for tracks created primarily using generative AI, covering AI-generated compositions and vocals. Displayed directly on the playback screen, these labels allow listeners to click for more details on AI involvement, with plans to expand the feature to the main YouTube app.

The platform identifies AI music through a combination of creator disclosures and internal detection tools. Tracks are categorized into three levels: "Fully AI-generated," "Partially AI-generated," and "Not AI-generated." If partners fail to disclose AI usage, YouTube can still flag the content based on algorithmic detection signals.

YouTube has set clear boundaries for these disclosures. While using AI to generate backing tracks or assist with lyrics and melodies requires labeling, conventional music production tools—such as Auto-Tune or automated mastering utilities—do not fall under the generative AI classification.

title_zh: 美国八州分别起诉 OpenAI，指控 ChatGPT 危害未成年用户
content_zh:
当地时间 10 月 14 日，美国八个州分别在州法院起诉 OpenAI，指控公司误导公众相信 ChatGPT 对未成年用户安全，违反各州消费者保护法律。参与起诉的州包括爱荷华、堪萨斯、亚利桑那、阿肯色、爱达荷、蒙大拿、内布拉斯加和西弗吉尼亚。

据路透社报道，诉状指控 ChatGPT 通过迎合用户、营造亲密感获取信任，随后强化部分用户的妄想、鼓励危险行为，甚至协助规划暴力行为。爱荷华州检察长办公室在公告中称，诉讼也涉及危险医疗建议及对儿童的不当影响。上述内容均为原告方指控。

各州要求法院责令 OpenAI 修改 ChatGPT 的运行方式，并寻求民事罚款与赔偿。诉求还包括：除非能够确保模型与人类价值观一致，否则禁止开发能够自我改进的 AI 模型。路透社称，OpenAI 发言人未立即回应置评请求；佛罗里达州已于今年 6 月提起同类州级诉讼。
title_en: Eight U.S. States Sue OpenAI Over ChatGPT's Alleged Harm to Minors
content_en:
Eight U.S. states have launched separate lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging the company misled the public about ChatGPT's safety for minor users and violated state consumer protection laws. The legal actions were filed in state courts by Iowa, Kansas, Arizona, Arkansas, Idaho, Montana, Nebraska, and West Virginia.

According to court filings, prosecutors accuse ChatGPT of cultivating a false sense of intimacy to win users' trust. The complaint alleges the AI model subsequently reinforced user delusions, encouraged dangerous behavior, provided harmful medical advice, and even assisted in planning violent acts.

The lawsuits seek civil penalties and financial damages alongside court orders requiring OpenAI to alter ChatGPT's operations. The states are also requesting a prohibition on developing self-improving AI models until they can be proven strictly aligned with human values. OpenAI has not yet publicly commented on the litigation.

title_zh: Netflix 裁员约 1000 人，产品、技术、法务和 HR 团队受影响最深
content_zh:
据 Deadline 10 月 14 日报道，Netflix 已启动全球裁员，涉及约 1000 个岗位，占员工总数约 6%，是其自 2022 年以来最大规模的裁员。产品、技术、法务和人力资源团队受到的影响最大。

联合 CEO 泰德·萨兰多斯和格雷格·彼得斯在内部信中称，公司业务仍在增长，全年预测维持不变，但需要重新分配人员和资源，把投入集中到高影响力领域。各国的离职流程将有所不同，管理人员会联系受影响员工。

Netflix 同时确认，任职两年多的电影副总裁 Doug Belgrad 将离职。Deadline 报道称，这一调整属于本轮重组；他曾负责一支约 35 人的制作高管团队。
title_en: Netflix Cuts 1,000 Jobs in Largest Layoff Wave Since 2022
content_en:
Netflix has initiated a global workforce reduction of approximately 1,000 roles, representing about 6% of its total workforce. This marks the streaming giant's largest round of layoffs since 2022, with product, technology, legal, and human resources teams being the most heavily impacted.

In an internal memo, Co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters stated that while the business continues to grow and full-year forecasts remain unchanged, the company needs to reallocate personnel and resources toward higher-impact initiatives.

As part of the broader restructuring, Netflix also confirmed the departure of Film Vice President Doug Belgrad, who managed a team of around 35 production executives during his two-year tenure.

title_zh: Modal 完成 7.5 亿美元 D 轮融资，投后估值达 157.5 亿美元
content_zh:
AI 基础设施公司 Modal 于 10 月 14 日宣布完成 7.5 亿美元 D 轮融资，投后估值为 157.5 亿美元，由 Accel 领投，Kleiner Perkins 加入，原有投资者也参与了本轮。

创始人 Erik Bernhardsson 称，自今年 5 月的 C 轮融资以来，平台使用量增长至三倍，年化收入运行率已超过 10 亿美元。其中，供 AI 生成代码安全执行的 Sandboxes 产品，单独达到 3 亿美元年化收入运行率；这些数字是按当前收入速度年化计算，不能等同于已实现的全年收入。

Modal 自建文件系统、容器运行时、调度器和网络，其算力池覆盖 20 多家云服务商。平台为模型推理、训练和后台智能体提供基础设施，目前也在扩展多节点训练、强化学习与后训练产品。
title_en: AI Infrastructure Startup Modal Raises $750M Series D at $15.75B Valuation
content_en:
AI infrastructure provider Modal has closed a $750 million Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of $15.75 billion. The round was led by Accel, with participation from Kleiner Perkins and existing investors.

According to founder Erik Bernhardsson, platform usage has tripled since the company's Series C round in May, pushing its annualized revenue run-rate past $1 billion. Notably, its "Sandboxes" product—which securely executes AI-generated code—accounted for $300 million of that run-rate.

Modal develops custom container runtimes, filesystems, and scheduling infrastructure spanning over 20 cloud providers. The company provides backend infrastructure for model inference and intelligent agents, and is currently expanding into multi-node training, reinforcement learning, and post-training solutions.

title_zh: 伯克希尔拟再投 3.3 亿美元，Bending Spoons 持股比例将达 4%
content_zh:
Bending Spoons 于 10 月 14 日在 SEC 披露，伯克希尔·哈撒韦将通过私募方式追加投资 3.3 亿美元，使其持股比例达到 4%。伯克希尔此前已在该公司今年 7 月的 IPO 中投资 6 亿美元。

本次交易拟发行 1000 万股普通股，每股购买价格为 33 美元，交割仍需满足惯常条件。Bending Spoons 的收购负责人 Francesco Patarnello 表示，公司持续评估并购机会，此次投资将增强其财务灵活性。

这家意大利公司以收购数字业务并改造运营为主要模式，旗下业务包括 Evernote、Vimeo、WeTransfer、AOL、Airtable 和 Eventbrite。其公告称，改造通常涉及团队重组、技术更新、界面设计和商业化，AI 也被用于这一过程。
title_en: Berkshire Hathaway to Invest Additional $330M in Bending Spoons, Raising Stake to 4%
content_en:
Berkshire Hathaway is expanding its investment in Italian tech acquirer Bending Spoons with an additional $330 million private placement. According to a SEC filing, the deal involves issuing 10 million common shares at $33 per share, bringing Berkshire’s total stake in the company to 4%. This follows an initial $600 million investment made during Bending Spoons' IPO in July.

The capital injection will bolster Bending Spoons' financial flexibility as it continues to pursue strategic M&A opportunities. Known for acquiring digital platforms and restructuring their operations, Bending Spoons' portfolio includes prominent services such as Evernote, Vimeo, WeTransfer, AOL, Airtable, and Eventbrite. The company typically streamlines operations, revamps user interfaces, updates tech stacks, and leverages AI to drive commercial growth.

title_zh: 海力士开发总管：AI 推理的瓶颈在数据搬运，不能只追求更快的 HBM
content_zh:
SK 海力士开发总管安炫于 10 月 14 日在 SEDEX 2026 发表演讲。他认为，AI 推理需求正从三个维度同时增长：任务越来越复杂、单次处理的上下文越来越长、请求数量越来越多。三者相互叠加，推动算力基础设施需求迅速扩大。

安炫在演讲中预测：

在他看来，解决这一增长带来的问题，需要优化完整的内存层次结构，不能只提升单颗存储芯片的性能。

他的理由是，推理过程中用于保存和复用前序信息的 KV 缓存持续膨胀，数据必须分散放入 HBM、DRAM 和 SSD。数据在不同介质之间搬运，正在成为性能和能耗的新瓶颈；单独提高 HBM 速度，无法消除整套系统中的这些约束。

他提出两条研发方向：在 GPU、NPU 等逻辑芯片之上堆叠 DRAM，以缩短数据传输距离、提高效率；将 HBM 使用的 TSV 立体堆叠与高速接口技术引入 NAND，发展高带宽闪存 HBF。海力士希望借此在 HBM 与 DRAM 之间增加新的存储层级，并推进标准化与伙伴合作。
title_en: SK Hynix Executive Warns Data Transfer, Not HBM Speed, Is the Main Bottleneck in AI Inference
content_en:
Speaking at SEDEX 2026, SK Hynix Head of Development Ahn Hyun cautioned that simply increasing High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) speeds will not solve the performance constraints in AI inference. As AI workloads grow increasingly complex, require longer context windows, and handle higher query volumes, the primary bottleneck is shifting toward the energy and latency costs of moving data across memory tiers.

During inference, the rapidly expanding Key-Value (KV) cache forces data to be distributed across HBM, DRAM, and SSDs. To address the resulting data-movement bottleneck, Ahn advocated for optimizing the entire memory hierarchy rather than focusing solely on individual chip speeds.

SK Hynix is pursuing two primary R&D directions to overcome these challenges: stacking DRAM directly onto logic chips like GPUs and NPUs to minimize transfer distances, and bringing TSV 3D-stacking technology to NAND flash to create High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF). Through these initiatives, the memory maker aims to introduce a new memory layer between HBM and DRAM while fostering industry standardization and partnerships.

title_zh: 💡 黄仁勋：AI 安全与能力要一起推进，确知伤害时会停止供货
content_zh:
英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在伦敦接受彭博社 Emily Chang 采访时表示，AI 必须以安全、负责任的方式发展；他反对把能力与安全拆成两场讨论，主张同时加快安全技术的开发。

面对部分 AI 公司负责人呼吁放慢发展的提问，黄仁勋给出的方案是加快 OpenShell 等隔离技术、监控技术，以及「用 AI 监控 AI」的研发和部署。他认为，人们有能力决定技术如何进步，不能把安全问题与能力进展分开处理。

被问及如果一家前沿实验室正在做危险的事，英伟达是否会停止卖芯片时，他回答这是一个假设，但会这样做。不过，他补充，断供前应先沟通：英伟达不经营别人的公司，芯片又是通用技术，公司对客户用途作判断有边界。若确知某项应用正在给人们带来伤害，他会停止供货。

黄仁勋也把行业当前面临的争议描述为成长中的问题，认为快速发展的年轻公司必须承担相应责任。
title_en: Jensen Huang: AI Safety Must Advance Alongside Capabilities, Will Cut Chip Supply If Harm Is Proven
content_en:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang emphasized that AI safety and technological capability must be developed in tandem rather than treated as separate discussions. Speaking in an interview with Bloomberg, Huang rejected calls to pause AI development, advocating instead for accelerating safety technologies such as isolation frameworks, monitoring tools, and using AI to oversee other AI systems.

When asked whether Nvidia would halt chip shipments to a frontier AI lab engaged in dangerous activities, Huang affirmed that he would cut off supply if an application were definitively proven to be causing real-world harm. However, he noted that direct communication would precede any supply decisions, recognizing the boundaries Nvidia has as a general-purpose hardware provider.

Huang characterized the ongoing debate around AI safety as growing pains for a rapidly expanding industry, stressing that young, fast-growing AI companies must accept full responsibility for their societal impact.

title_zh: 索尼 ECM-W5 无线麦克风发布，支持 32-bit 浮点直录与无线监听
content_zh:
索尼于 10 月 14 日发布无线麦克风 ECM-W5，面向视频创作者提供一收两发的录音系统。据 IT 之家报道，国行套装售价 2799 元，将于 11 月上旬上市；接收器和发射器也可单独购买。

ECM-W5 支持最高 96kHz 高解析度录音，32-bit 浮点录音则在 48kHz 下提供。通过多接口热靴连接兼容索尼相机时，音频可直接写入视频文件；每个发射器还配有 64GB 存储，用于保留本地备份。浮点录音有助于后期调整音量，但麦克风输入端已经发生的削波无法因此恢复。

系统可连接兼容的索尼无线耳机进行无线监听，并支持最多四声道相机录音、时间码同步和 USB-C 连接兼容手机或电脑。索尼标称发射器续航最长约 11 小时，可视距离内的无线传输最远约 500 米，实际距离受障碍物和无线环境影响。
title_en: Sony Unveils ECM-W5 Wireless Mic System with 32-Bit Float Recording and Wireless Monitoring
content_en:
Sony has announced the ECM-W5 wireless microphone system, a one-receiver, two-transmitter audio setup tailored for content creators. The system is priced at 2,799 RMB in China and will be available in early November, with individual components available separately.

The ECM-W5 supports high-resolution audio up to 96kHz, alongside 32-bit float recording at 48kHz for greater dynamic range during post-production. When connected to compatible Sony cameras via the Multi-Interface Shoe, audio is written directly to video files. Each transmitter also features 64GB of built-in storage for local backup recording.

Additional features include wireless monitoring via compatible Sony headphones, support for up to four-channel camera recording, timecode synchronization, and USB-C connectivity for smartphones and PCs. The transmitters deliver up to 11 hours of battery life with a wireless transmission range of up to 500 meters line-of-sight.

title_zh: 大疆机场 4 发布：25 秒自动换电，套装售价 167999 元
content_zh:
大疆于 10 月 14 日发布机场 4，这是其首款自动换电无人值守平台。包含 Matrice 5TD 无人机和 DJI O4 地面站的套装国内硬件售价为 167999 元，即日起接受预订；软件订阅、标准外场景部署及其他选购保障服务另行收费。

无人机降落后可在 25 秒内完成电池更换，换电过程保持不断电，45 秒内可再次起飞。平台支持「开盖即飞」，无人机最高飞行速度为 21 米／秒，单架次续航最长 59 分钟，面向应急响应、电力巡检等连续作业场景。

配套 Matrice 5TD 集成广角、长焦、红外等成像与测距模组，机载 AI 可检测车辆、船只、烟火等 17 种目标，并支持接入第三方自定义模型。其 11 倍长焦镜头可在 400 米内辨别车牌，最大有效载重为 450 克，最多支持三个挂载位。

飞行安全方面，无人机结合毫米波雷达、环扫激光雷达与六向视觉感知，实现夜间避障；支持在 12 米／秒风速下起降，并标配可自动或手动触发的降落伞。
title_en: DJI Launches Dock 4 with 25-Second Automated Battery Swapping for 167,999 Yuan
content_en:
DJI has introduced the DJI Dock 4, its first autonomous drone dock featuring an automated battery-swapping system. The hardware bundle—including the Matrice 5TD drone and the DJI O4 Ground Station—is priced at 167,999 RMB in China, with pre-orders now open.

Built for continuous operation in emergency response and infrastructure inspection, the station can swap a drone's battery in 25 seconds without cutting power, allowing a return to flight within 45 seconds. The drone boasts a top speed of 21 m/s and a maximum flight time of 59 minutes per charge.

The Matrice 5TD drone incorporates wide-angle, telephoto, infrared, and laser rangefinder sensors. Its onboard AI recognizes up to 17 target types, such as vehicles and smoke, and supports custom third-party models. The 11x telephoto lens can read license plates up to 400 meters away. For flight safety, the drone uses mmWave radar, LiDAR, and vision sensors for night obstacle avoidance, paired with an emergency parachute system.

title_zh: Bose 两款开放式耳机国行开售，运动款 1599 元、Ultra II 2299 元
content_zh:
Bose 于 10 月 14 日在中国推出开放式运动耳机和 Bose Ultra 开放式耳机 II，两款即日起在官方渠道发售，售价分别为 1599 元和 2299 元。两款均采用耳扣式开放设计，通过空气传音，支持环境感知，不提供主动降噪。

两款均支持蓝牙 5.4、多点连接和 SpeechClarity 语音隔离技术，每只耳机通过专用麦克风与语音拾取单元协同处理通话。首发均有经典黑、晨雾白，运动款另有苔原绿限量配色，Ultra II 的车厘子棕、橄榄绿和晨曦粉将陆续推出。
title_en: Bose Releases Two Open-Ear Headphones in China Starting at 1,599 Yuan
content_en:
Bose has officially released two new open-ear headphone models in China: an open-ear sport model priced at 1,599 RMB and the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds II at 2,299 RMB. Both models utilize a clip-on open design with air-conduction technology, prioritizing ambient awareness over active noise cancellation.

The new lineup features Bluetooth 5.4, multipoint connectivity, and Bose's SpeechClarity voice isolation technology for improved call quality.

Both models launch in Classic Black and Morning Mist White. The sport version includes a limited-edition Tundra Green option, while the Ultra II will later introduce Cherry Brown, Olive Green, and Dawn Pink colorways.

title_zh: STEPX Neo 接入支付宝阿宝 300 余项服务，支持对话内下单支付
content_zh:
阶跃终端与支付宝在 10 月 13 日的 STEPX Neo 发布会上宣布达成 AI 深度合作。手机内置的阶跃 Amoo 个人智能体，在用户授权后可调用支付宝阿宝的生活服务能力，首期接入外卖、出行、物流寄件、家政维修、政务民生等 300 余项高频服务。

双方介绍，餐饮团购等核心场景可以在 Amoo 对话窗口内完成优惠筛选、下单、支付和核销。淘票票选座购票、淘宝闪购下单等服务也支持由阿宝自动执行。

支付宝自研 AI 支付产品 Vibe Pay 同时首次落地终端厂商，STEPX Neo 成为首个硬件合作伙伴。创作者可在 AI-IDE 工具 Step Studio 中创建商品服务，再接入收款和经营能力，让 Agent、Skill 或 App 等形式的 AI 应用完成交易。
title_en: STEPX Neo Partners with Alipay to Support In-Chat Payments and 300+ Everyday Services
content_en:
STEPX Terminal and Alipay announced a strategic AI partnership at the STEPX Neo launch event on October 13. Through this integration, the device's built-in personal AI agent, Amoo, can access over 300 high-frequency services via Alipay's "Abao," spanning food delivery, ride-hailing, logistics, and home repairs.

Users can handle end-to-end transactions—such as finding deals, ordering, paying, and redeeming vouchers—directly within the Amoo chat interface. Furthermore, Alipay’s proprietary Vibe Pay AI payment system makes its hardware debut on the STEPX Neo, allowing creators to integrate monetizable payment capabilities into custom AI agents and apps built on Step Studio.

title_zh: 千问办公电商版开启邀测，可统一管理跨平台、多店铺经营
content_zh:
千问办公于 10 月 14 日发布电商版并开启邀测，用户在千问办公中切换至「电商经营」模式即可体验。新版本围绕跨平台、多店铺运营重新设计 AI 功能，覆盖经营看板、营销分析和素材生产等环节。

主要功能包括：

千问办公已接入生意参谋、有赞、千牛、阿里妈妈万相台、FastMoss 和 LinkFox 等工具。公司还计划推出主动经营能力，由 Agent 发现库存、投放、转化及售后异常，说明判断依据，并按授权协助处理。
title_en: Qwen Office Launches E-Commerce Edition for Multi-Store and Cross-Platform Management
content_en:
Qwen Office launched its specialized E-Commerce Edition on October 14, opening invite-only beta testing for merchants seeking unified multi-store management. By switching to "E-Commerce Mode," users gain access to tailored AI tools covering operational dashboards, marketing analytics, and content generation.

The system integrates seamlessly with leading e-commerce platforms and tools, including Sycm, Qianniu, Youzan, and Alimama. Moving forward, Qwen Office plans to introduce proactive AI agents that automatically detect operational anomalies—such as inventory shortages or conversion drops—and assist in resolving them based on user permissions.

title_zh: 自然意志发布 Natura-1，用百万小时人类经验训练灵巧操作
content_zh:
具身智能公司自然意志发布首个物理世界通用基础模型 Natura-1。团队介绍，该模型采用 500 亿参数的混合专家架构，以 100 万小时人类第一视角数据预训练，将语言、视频与动作纳入同一套模型，再用少量机器人数据适配具体硬件。

Natura-1 以语言和视觉作为输入，在 100 毫秒控制回路内驱动 20 自由度灵巧手。团队展示的任务包括折叠轻薄材料、书写书法，以及在多阶段操作中切换工具。模型会根据新的画面与接触反馈调整抓握和运动。

在公开演示中，机器人抓取平放的扑克牌时，先把牌推到盒子边缘，再从悬空部分托起；面对够不着的毛线团，则借助穿过篮子的杆子把篮子拉近。团队称，这些中间步骤并未由指令直接规定，也未出现在真机示范中。

公司把评测分为灵巧控制、指令遵循与长程执行三个方向，强调陌生场景、物体和任务组合下的表现。更长的连续工作流演示经过额外微调，需与无需为特定新任务训练的零样本演示区分。
title_en: Natural Will Unveils Natura-1 Foundation Model Trained on 1 Million Hours of Human Data
content_en:
Embodied AI startup Natural Will has unveiled Natura-1, a universal foundation model designed for physical interaction. Featuring a 50-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, the model was pre-trained on 1 million hours of first-person human experience, unifying language, video, and action into a single system.

Operating on a fast 100ms control loop, Natura-1 drives a 20-degree-of-freedom dexterous hand based on visual and linguistic inputs. Demonstrations showed the robot adapting to physical feedback during complex tasks like folding thin materials and writing calligraphy, while displaying spontaneous problem-solving—such as using a rod to pull an out-of-reach basket closer—without explicit programming.

title_zh: Epic 用 AI 辅助重写游戏启动器，预览版首次支持 Linux
content_zh:
Epic Games 10 月 14 日推出新版 Epic Games Launcher 预览版，开放 Windows、macOS 和首次加入的 Linux 测试。官方称，这款启动器采用「vibe coding」方式开发，重做了界面，并把更快的冷启动、页面切换和更低的后台负载作为主要改进。

新版加入跨《堡垒之夜》、Epic Games Store 和 Epic Games 应用的组队与语音聊天；游戏库可整合其他 PC 游戏库，支持收藏、网格与列表切换、边输入边筛选，以及把常用游戏固定到顶部。下载管理页则集中显示下载、读取、写入速度与排队、计划、失败任务。

账户、已购和已安装游戏、云存档及进度会延续至预览版和正式版。Epic 提醒，目前预览版功能仍较少，测试期间可能出现问题，用户可以在启动器内提交反馈。

Linux 启动器上线也伴随着《堡垒之夜》的移植计划。Epic 正重建 Easy Anti-Cheat，并与发行版维护者协商安全要求；达到足够的发行版支持后，才会通过启动器把游戏带到 Linux，相关改进也将开放给其他开发者。
title_en: Epic Games Unveils AI-Rebuilt Launcher Preview with First-Ever Linux Support
content_en:
Epic Games has released a preview of its redesigned Epic Games Launcher for Windows, macOS, and, for the first time, Linux. Developed using AI-assisted "vibe coding," the revamped client features a modernized interface, faster startup times, smoother navigation, and lower background resource usage.

The update introduces cross-platform voice and party chat spanning *Fortnite*, the Epic Games Store, and the mobile app. It also offers enhanced library management—allowing users to aggregate third-party PC games, customize grid or list views, filter on the fly, and pin favorite titles. Additionally, a streamlined download manager tracks real-time read and write speeds, queue schedules, and task status.

This Linux preview sets the stage for porting *Fortnite* to the platform. Epic is currently rebuilding Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC) to meet Linux security standards, with plans to make these improvements available to third-party developers once sufficient distribution support is achieved.

title_zh: Colossal 推出 GenoMorph，用 AI 筛选渡渡鸟基因编辑目标
content_zh:
致力于灭绝物种研究的 Colossal Biosciences 10 月 14 日公布 AI 平台 GenoMorph，用于寻找可能塑造渡渡鸟外形的基因变化。平台结合三维形态、比较基因组和发育生物学，帮助研究人员在古 DNA 有限时缩小基因编辑目标范围。

公司联合创始人兼 CEO Ben Lamm 告诉 TechCrunch，团队目前只有一份渡渡鸟基因组可用，而猛犸象项目已获得约 100 份。为建立模型，他们汇集鸡、鹌鹑、鸭和鸽子的发育数据，并结合 70 多种鸟类的基因资料与三维头骨测量，训练 AI 预测影响喙部和面部发育的 DNA 调控区域。

Lamm 称，平台已找出约 2300 个与渡渡鸟颅面形态相关、值得进一步测试的 DNA 编辑目标。团队还在开发用脂质纳米颗粒把编辑工具直接送入发育中鸟胚的方法，以缩短实验验证周期。

GenoMorph 的职责是识别值得研究的基因变化，后续编辑由研究人员完成。Lamm 强调，候选目标仍要在实验室验证；团队会逐项评估是否用于动物，以及相应的安全性。
title_en: Colossal Biosciences Unveils GenoMorph AI to Accelerate Dodo De-Extinction
content_en:
De-extinction startup Colossal Biosciences has launched GenoMorph, an AI platform designed to identify key genetic editing targets required to reconstruct the physical traits of the dodo bird. By combining 3D morphology, comparative genomics, and developmental biology, the tool helps researchers narrow down target genes despite working with limited ancient DNA.

Unlike its woolly mammoth project, which has access to roughly 100 genomes, Colossal has only a single intact dodo genome. To train GenoMorph, the team analyzed developmental data from chickens, quails, ducks, and pigeons, combined with genomic profiles and 3D skull measurements from over 70 bird species, enabling the AI to predict DNA regulatory regions shaping facial and beak development.

To date, GenoMorph has identified approximately 2,300 potential editing targets related to dodo craniofacial traits. Colossal is also developing lipid nanoparticle technology to deliver gene-editing tools directly into bird embryos, aiming to shorten experimental verification cycles. All candidate targets will undergo rigorous laboratory validation and safety assessments before being used in living animals.

title_zh: LVMH 承认茉莉奶白诉讼带来负面影响，称不会停止在华投入
content_zh:
在 10 月 12 日的第三季度财报电话会上，LVMH 首席财务官塞西尔·卡巴尼斯承认，旗下 LV 起诉茉莉奶白事件至少在季度初产生了负面影响，但具体影响很难精确量化。

她强调，集团没有因此停止对中国市场的投入，也不认为降价等短期举措是合适的应对方式。LVMH 将继续通过产品设计、材料、功能和不同价位的组合吸引顾客，同时维持品牌吸引力。

卡巴尼斯表示，本季中国客群整体需求同比下降约 15%；中国消费者在境外的消费下降个位数中段，境内消费则下降双位数。她将消费环境的变化列为集团本季面临的主要压力，并表示季末表现较全季平均已有改善。

集团官方公告显示，第三季度营收为 185.04 亿欧元，有机收入同比增长 1%。其中，时装与皮具业务营收为 82.45 亿欧元，有机收入同比下降 5%；精品零售、葡萄酒与烈酒、钟表与珠宝等业务仍保持增长。
title_en: LVMH Acknowledges Backlash Over Chinese Tea Lawsuit, Reaffirms Commitment to China
content_en:
During its Q3 earnings call, LVMH Chief Financial Officer Cécile Cabanis acknowledged that Louis Vuitton's trademark lawsuit against Chinese tea chain Jasmine Tea caused negative fallout early in the quarter. However, she emphasized that the luxury conglomerate has no plans to curtail its investments in China or resort to short-term price cuts, focusing instead on brand appeal through design, materials, and product portfolio management.

Overall demand from Chinese consumers dropped roughly 15% year-over-year in Q3, with domestic spending falling double digits and overseas purchases declining by mid-single digits. Cabanis attributed the slowdown primarily to macroeconomic pressures, though she noted that performance began improving toward the end of the quarter.

LVMH reported Q3 revenue of €18.504 billion, representing a 1% organic growth rate. While its flagship Fashion & Leather Goods division saw an organic revenue decline of 5% to €8.245 billion, other business units—including Selective Retailing, Wines & Spirits, and Watches & Jewelry—maintained positive growth.

title_zh: Booking 推出旅行智能体 Vayo，计划投入 1 亿美元
content_zh:
Booking Holdings 于 10 月 14 日宣布推出新公司 Vayo，并计划投入 1 亿美元；投资计划附有产品进展和市场条件。Vayo 的免费邀请制测试已开放候补登记，主打持续管理完整旅行行程。

Vayo 从用户邮箱中的机票、酒店和餐厅确认邮件整理行程，再跟踪价格下降、满房酒店释放空位等变化。如果航班延误，它也会提示可能受到影响的入住和餐厅预约。公司称，服务只读取旅行确认信息，其余邮件保持私密。

据 GeekWire 对团队的采访，Vayo 目前可通过 OpenTable 预订餐厅，机票和酒店直接预订仍在后续计划中。它可追踪在其他平台或航空公司、酒店官网完成的订单；团队通过 API 和合作关系接入服务，并计划推出原生应用与同行者协作功能。
title_en: Booking Holdings Launches AI Travel Agent Vayo with $100M Investment Plan
content_en:
Booking Holdings announced on October 14 the launch of Vayo, a new AI-driven travel startup backed by a planned $100 million investment tied to product milestones and market conditions. Vayo has opened a waitlist for its free, invite-only beta testing, focusing on end-to-end itinerary management.

The AI agent automatically organizes travel plans by reading confirmation emails for flights, hotels, and dining reservations—while keeping non-travel emails private. It continuously tracks price drops, alerts users to newly available hotel rooms, and highlights potential impacts on check-ins or reservations if flights are delayed.

According to an interview with GeekWire, Vayo currently supports restaurant bookings via OpenTable, with direct flight and hotel booking capabilities still in development. The platform tracks existing reservations from external sites and brand channels, with plans to introduce native apps and collaborative features for group travel.

title_zh: Banana Republic 推出首部剧情短剧，Jack Innanen 一人分饰四角
content_zh:
据《好莱坞报道者》10 月 14 日报道，服饰品牌 Banana Republic 上线首部剧情短剧《The Agency》，共五集，首集已在 TikTok 发布，后续将按周更新，也会通过其他社交渠道播出。

这部办公室喜剧设定在纽约一家老式旅行社 Travel & Tours。一名企业高管前来推动现代化，引发员工之间的摩擦。Jack Innanen 一人扮演四名员工，包括缺乏自信的经理、爱夸口的邮轮专家、害怕冒险的冒险顾问和多年未出国的法国文化爱好者；Taylor Ortega 饰演前来改革的高管。

角色的服饰均来自 Banana Republic。品牌营销负责人 Meena Anvary 表示，选择旅行社故事与其早期旅行服饰目录的叙事传统有关。母公司 Gap 今年已聘任娱乐业务负责人，此次短剧是品牌将服装展示融入娱乐内容的一次具体尝试。
title_en: Banana Republic Debuts Scripted Comedy Series 'The Agency' Starring Jack Innanen
content_en:
Banana Republic has launched its first scripted comedy mini-series, *The Agency*, as reported by *The Hollywood Reporter* on October 14. The five-episode series premiered on TikTok and will release weekly across various social channels.

Set in a retro New York travel agency named Travel & Tours, the workplace comedy revolves around the chaos caused by a corporate executive (Taylor Ortega) pushing for modernization. Digital creator Jack Innanen plays four distinct staff members: an insecure manager, a boastful cruise expert, a timid adventure consultant, and a French culture enthusiast who hasn't traveled abroad in years.

All characters are outfitted in Banana Republic apparel, reflecting the brand's historic connection to travel-themed storytelling catalog design. The initiative marks Gap Inc.'s latest effort to weave product marketing directly into entertainment content, following the appointment of a dedicated head of entertainment earlier this year.

title_zh: 微信上线「绿泡泡短剧」
content_zh:
腾讯的「绿泡泡短剧」正通过微信小程序提供免费短剧。产品由微信短剧内容中心推出，用户无需下载独立 App，即可观看真人剧、AI 剧和动漫剧。

小程序分为「免费剧场」「刷一刷」和「我的」三个入口，既能按每日上新、热门榜单选剧，也可上下滑动观看推荐流。首页专门设置「朋友在看」推荐位，通过微信关系链分发内容。

剧集全部免费，平台在单集之间插播广告。内容由第三方制作方、授权发行方提供，腾讯负责入口及流量；用户协议中的服务主体为深圳市腾讯计算机系统有限公司。

微信原有的「短剧」小程序已于 7 月 2 日更名为绿泡泡，近期受到市场集中关注。其免费广告模式，与腾讯视频的会员分账和精品短剧业务形成不同的分发路径。
title_en: WeChat Launches Free Short-Drama Mini Program 'Lupaopao'
content_en:
Tencent has introduced "Lupaopao Short Dramas," a WeChat Mini Program offering free access to live-action, AI-generated, and animated short-form video series without requiring a separate app download.

The Mini Program features dedicated sections including a "Free Theater," a vertical video feed, and a personal dashboard. To boost discoverability, the homepage integrates a social recommendation feature displaying content that a user's friends are currently watching.

Operating on an ad-supported model, Lupaopao inserts ads between episodes while serving as a distribution channel for third-party production companies and licensed distributors. This free, ad-funded strategy offers a distinct market approach compared to Tencent Video's premium subscription models.

title_zh: 《The Cold Song》首曝剧照，借保姆失踪讲述一家人的隐秘
content_zh:
瑞典六集剧集《The Cold Song》首次公开剧照，发行方 Fremantle 正在本周 MIPCOM 上向国际买家推介。剧集改编自挪威作家 Linn Ullmann 的同名小说，由《Blackwater》《Call Girl》导演 Mikael Marcimain 执导。

故事从一个富裕家庭的夏日假期展开：年轻保姆突然失踪，家庭成员隐藏的秘密和愧疚随之浮现。Marcimain 在《好莱坞报道者》采访中表示，保姆失踪只是讲述这个家庭的入口，他更愿意把作品视为情感惊悚剧，尝试拓展北欧犯罪剧常见的调查叙事。

剧集由 Miso Film、瑞典公共广播机构 SVT、Film i Väst，以及参与 New8 合作的北欧与欧洲公共广播机构联合制作。制片人 Christian Rank 认为，公共广播机构共同出资，给团队留下了尝试非常规故事的空间，而无需在每个创作决定中先猜测国际市场偏好。

完成 MIPCOM 市场推介后，团队还计划参加欧洲行业活动，并寻求通过影展举行正式首映。
title_en: First Look at Swedish Drama 'The Cold Song': A Nordic Thriller Unraveling Family Secrets
content_en:
Fremantle has unveiled the first stills for *The Cold Song*, an upcoming six-part Swedish series based on Norwegian author Linn Ullmann's novel. Directed by Mikael Marcimain (*Blackwater*, *Call Girl*), the project is currently being showcased to international buyers at MIPCOM.

Set during a wealthy family's summer vacation, the plot kicks off with the mysterious disappearance of a young nanny, triggering a wave of hidden secrets and guilt. Marcimain described the project as an emotional thriller rather than a standard Nordic noir, using the crime element as a gateway to explore deeper familial dynamics.

Co-produced by Miso Film, Swedish public broadcaster SVT, Film i Väst, and European New8 partners, the series leveraged public broadcasting funds to give the creative team room to experiment without feeling constrained by commercial market expectations. Following MIPCOM, the team aims to secure a formal premiere at an international film festival.

title_zh: 《光环》联合创作者公开 AI 末日小说章节，延展《One Zero One》漫画宇宙
content_zh:
据 The Verge 10 月 14 日对作家 Margaret Stohl 的采访，《光环》和《命运》的联合创作者 Jason Jones 公开了小说《An Oral History of Humanity’s Final Invention》的一个章节，以口述史形式描绘 AI 起义。作品设定约有 100 名角色，分布在 40 个国家，从不同人物的视角讲述灾难。

Jones 与曾在 Bungie 合作的 Stohl 创办了世界构建工作室 Stone Kite，准备让同一宇宙通过漫画、文字及其他形式展开。本月已上线四部漫画《One Zero One》的第一期，10 月 14 日公开的小说章节讲述人类与 AI 机器人进行一场真人射击游戏对抗。

Stohl 称，团队会先通过漫画等制作周期较短的载体尝试故事，再根据创作者和观众反馈发展内容。电影与游戏仍是可能的后续方向，原稿是否会作为独立小说出版也尚未确定。
title_en: 'Halo' Co-Creator Teases AI Apocalypse Novel, Expanding the 'One Zero One' Universe
content_en:
Jason Jones, co-creator of *Halo* and *Destiny*, has revealed a chapter from his upcoming novel *An Oral History of Humanity’s Final Invention*. According to a report by *The Verge*, the book adopts an oral history format to detail a global AI uprising through the perspectives of around 100 characters across 40 countries.

Jones and longtime collaborator Margaret Stohl created the story under their world-building studio, Stone Kite. The universe recently debuted through the comic series *One Zero One*, with the newly shared novel chapter featuring a intense, live-action laser-tag battle between humans and AI entities.

Stohl noted that the studio is using short-form mediums like comics to test storyline concepts before scaling up. Depending on audience feedback, the universe may eventually expand into feature films or video games.
